description: One model's BenchLeader profile: Index and rank, category scores, list price, speed, latency, context window, its other reasoning-effort configurations, and its strongest independent benchmark results (each with its board rank, publisher and source link).

effort.description: Reasoning-effort configuration to show (none, low, medium, high, xhigh, max…). Defaults to the best-ranked one.

model.description: Model id ("claude-opus-5-5"), configuration id ("gpt-6-astra@max"), page URL or name.

results_limit.description: How many benchmark results to return (at most 50).

name: get_model
title: Model details
